sources.title: Qwen3.5 35B A3B (Q8_K_XL) on CPU Only | Prositronic
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 35B A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts model from Alibaba's Qwen team with 35 billion total parameters but only 3 billion active per token, routed across 256 experts for extreme efficiency. It is natively multimodal, processing text, images, and video, with built-in thinking capabilities for chain-of-thought reasoning.
